user.title: Ochsner heat pump (local)
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your heat pump. No cloud account is needed: the integration scans the controller with its built-in datapoint catalog (best effort; coverage varies by model, firmware and fitted options). Ensure this IP is static/reserved in your router.

advanced.title: Advanced connection settings
advanced.description: Only needed for plants that do not use the standard Climatix credentials/PIN. Leave the defaults unless your controller was reconfigured.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Climatix controller at this IP (check the address and that the device is on your network).
error.auth_failed: The controller rejected the standard credentials. Use the advanced settings to enter your controller's username/password.
error.probe_failed: Connected, but no catalog datapoint was readable. This usually means a non-default PIN — use the advanced settings to enter it.

init.title: Options
init.description: Gated polling default threshold is 20. You can increase it if you see connection errors.

data.local_scan_now: Local catalog scan now (accountless; add missing entities)
data.redownload_bundle: Re-download bundle from OTS (add missing entities)
data.configure_entities: Configure sensor/number device class and unit

entity_override_select.title: Entity overrides
entity_override_select.description: Select an entity to override its device class and unit.

entity_override_edit.title: Edit entity override
entity_override_edit.description: Set overrides for the selected entity. Leave fields empty to keep defaults.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Please enter a polling interval of at least 1 second.
error.invalid_polling_threshold: Please enter a gated polling threshold between 10 and 120.
error.invalid_max_ids: Please enter a max values-per-request between 1 and 200.
error.invalid_range: Maximum must be greater than minimum.
error.no_entities: The downloaded bundle produced no entities; nothing was changed.
error.no_controllers: This entry has no controllers to update.
error.no_bundle_key: No stored bundle key found for this controller.
error.no_ots_ids: The OTS config/site id is missing for this controller.
